title: Multistage cutover safety operator for hosted API regional rollouts
creator: Anita Patel
description: Implement a multistage "cutover safety operator" that coordinates blue/green regional upgrades, progressive traffic attenuation, and automated rollback gates for the Hosted API. This operator lives in the control plane and orchestrates: staged weight shifts across regional gateways, per-model-version LTS channel adherence, SLO-based hold points, and automated fallbacks to compatible model variants when thresholds are breached. Goal: reduce blast radius for cross-region upgrades and ensure predictable, measurable rollouts with automatic safeguards.
acceptance_criteria: Operator can start a regional multistage cutover from the Console or CLI and record a rollout ID
Support for declarative stages: canary (0.5-2%), ramp (5-50%), steady (100%), with configurable time windows
Automatic gate evaluation using telemetry: error-rate, p99 latency, GPU queue depth, token throughput
Automatic rollback executed within the stage if any configured metric exceeds threshold for 3 consecutive evaluation windows
Integration tests simulating increased error rate cause a stage rollback in CI with deterministic assertions
Audit logs emitted to the customer audit stream and internal runbook links attached to rollout events
Console displays per-stage health and provides a one-click abort and manual promote option
steps_plan: Design operator CRD and API: rollout spec, stages[], termination policy, fallback model mapping
Implement evaluator library that ingests metrics from Grafana/Prometheus and Cloud tracing (latency + error + saturation)
Create weight-shift executor that talks to regional gateways and canary proxies; include deterministic token sampling
Build canary traffic sampler: header-based and token-prefix sampling modes
Add automatic rollback controller and audit events, wire into Console and Console notifications
End-to-end tests in staging that run controlled chaos: inject latency/errors and verify rollback/promote behaviors
Deploy to a single non-critical region, gather telemetry and iterate thresholds before cross-region rollout
decisions: Use controller pattern (operator) in the control plane rather than agent in each region to simplify coordination and centralize audit logs
Sampling: prefer header-based deterministic sampling for live customer traffic; fallback to token-prefix sampling for legacy clients
Rollback policy: 3 consecutive evaluation windows breaching threshold -> automatic rollback. Chosen to avoid flapping on transient spikes
Model fallback: prefer narrower quantized variant of same model if available (to preserve behavior) rather than switching to a different architecture
Gate metrics prioritized in order: customer-facing error-rate, p99 latency, token throughput backlog, then infra saturation metrics
Defer runtime-level kernel/quantization changes to separate rollout track to reduce blast radius for model code changes

blockers: Runtime telemetry: need a stable 'token_inflight' metric in non-prod regions (ENG-20456 referenced)
Gateway API rate limit prevents repeated rapid weight changes during short test windows — working with infra to add a 'test-mode' bypass
Security review outstanding for operator RBAC scoping; must be approved before deploying to customer-facing regions
notes_for_oncall: Runbook link above — primary oncall should watch rollout ID in Console and 'rollout.health' metric
If automatic rollback fails, manual abort from Console and escalate to Runtime oncall (tag: @runtime-oncall)
Use 'promote' only after verifying p99 latency and error-rate for 3 successive intervals
For cross-region incidents, enable regional quarantine (operator flag) to prevent automatic propagation
rollout_config_proposal: Default stages: canary 1% for 30 minutes, ramp to 10% for 1 hour, ramp to 50% for 2 hours, steady 100%
Evaluation window: 60s, require 3 consecutive windows breaching thresholds for rollback
Default thresholds: customer error-rate > 0.5% for canary, >0.2% for steady; p99 latency > 150ms for more than 5% of traces
Saturation guard: GPU queue length > 70% of configured buffer triggers hold, not immediate rollback
Fallback model mapping: if primary model is unavailable, map to a pinned compatible variant (defined per-model in model-catalog)
Logging: emit rollout.event.{start,stage,hold,rollback,promote,complete} with rollout_id and region tags
reviews: PM review (Jordan Lee): asked for clearer UX on manual overrides; added 'soft-pause' option
Design review (Maya Chen): requested in-panel context help and link to runbook; implemented
Security review (in progress): requested least-privilege RBAC rules and audit emittance; currently iterating
implementation_notes: Prefer eventual-consistent operations for weight updates to avoid global locks; use compare-and-swap for regional gateway states
Expose an 'observability token' in rollout spec so teams can attach custom Prometheus alert rules to a rollout
Add synthetic traffic job option for canaries to validate model outputs under load (opt-in per customer)
Operator will write a rollout manifest to S3 with a signed URL for customers with Private deployments
